text: RETENTION ~4 in 10 students drop out of college. About 2M a year leave with student loan debt, but no degree to help pay for that debt. National Center for Education Statistics
COMPLETION ~60% of students don't finish a bachelor's in 4 years (about 40% still haven't in 6). Time-to-degree keeps stretching. NCES graduation rates
HIGHER WITHDRAWAL RATES 10–15% for lower income and underprepared students in online courses. Columbia University
RETENTION ~1 in 3 first-year students don't return for year two. Seats and tuition that never come back. NCES / IPEDS retention
EARNINGS AND EMPLOYMENT ~$1M & 2x less in lifetime earnings without a degree, and twice as likely to be unemployed. Pew Research Center
